entries.scope: Eight literal public BIP-173 vectors, one invalid variant, and reuse of one valid vector for encode/decode round-trip. Not Fabius-originated test data. No upstream source file or reference implementation is bundled by this record. The BIP-340 and NIP-44 vector files are fetched separately on demand and are not shipped.
